Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the performance on the proof-of-concept cluster and want to move forward with Cerulean-XS for our customer-facing product. Two asks from our side before procurement can finalize the purchase:

1) Can Redwood onboard the Cerulean-XS variant (recommended tag: cerulean_xs:3.0.1) and provide a stable pin for the Dedicated pool we'll be reserving? We need deterministic behavior across deployments for compliance reasons.
2) We need a short mutual action plan (MOP) that lists canary dates, fallback variants, and telemetry that Redwood will capture.

I've attached the draft MOP and a summary of our expected token distribution. Procurement is looping in the legal team and will need the pinning guarantee noted in the SOW.

Can your team outline an intake/compatibility timeline and any technical blockers you foresee? We aim for a pilot in the first two weeks of July.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

Vanessa / team — reviewed Acme sample and the Cerulean-XS release notes. Quick compatibility summary:

- Tokenizer parity: Cerulean-XS v3 changed BPE merges vs v2; we will need a tokenizer pass to ensure embedding and reranker parity. Not a showstopper but impacts prompt engineering.
- KV cache footprint: v3 increases KV cache per token ~18% in our perf tests; for their Dedicated pool sizing we'll need an extra 1–2x RAM headroom on inference nodes.
- Quantization path: v3 introduces a fused attention kernel that is not yet in our CUDA optimized path; we'll fallback to the generic kernel which increases median p99 by ~35ms on T4-class hardware. On A100/RTX this is smaller (~12ms).

Proposed mitigations:
1) Stage a canary on a small Dedicated slice (2 nodes) tagged cerulean_xs:3.0.1; run synthetic token distributions and customer-supplied sample.
2) Keep an automatic fallback to cerulean_xs:2.9 if latency regression exceeds SLO (configurable threshold).
3) Add tokenizer normalization in the intake pipeline and validate eval prompts.

I'll put a short compat report in Drive and attach a baseline spreadsheet. Happy to pair on the canary runbook.

Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager — Inference Runtime

Attachments: compat_report_v2.xlsx
From: priyom_das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: FW: Cerulean-XS onboarding and stable pin request

Team — telemetry / eval gating items I need to unblock pin approvals:

- Latency SLO target (p50/p95/p99) for pilot and production. Acme, can you confirm your SLOs? If not, we'll propose p95 < 220ms on A100 equivalent for their workload.
- Token distribution sample (anonymized) — this will help pick batching and KV cache sizing. The sample in the MOP is helpful but we need ~1000 request traces.
- Regression eval set: 150 prompts that represent customer-facing flows and 3 automated quality checks (BLEU-ish / exact-match heuristics + risk classifier).
- Telemetry retention: for the canary we'll keep 30 days at full fidelity, then downsample to 90-day aggregate. Need procurement sign-off for retention.

Operational asks: enable /metrics/variant and /trace/ingress tags for the pilot, and flag any fallback events to the Acme account in the Console.

I can spin up the telemetry dashboard and baseline alerts if we get the sample token traces by EOD Wed.

Priyom
Product Manager — Optimize
